title: SASjs Server
tagline: Stored programs in JavaScript and Python
author: 4GL Ltd

restrict-access.message: Restrict this app to the users and groups who should reach it: open the app's **Settings > Access control** and choose "Only allow the following users and groups". A Cloudron install is unrestricted by default, and here that hands the administrator seat to whoever signs in first - on an app that executes whatever is uploaded to SASjs Drive.

first-user-becomes-admin.message: There is no pre-created admin account. The FIRST user to sign in becomes the administrator; every user after that is a normal user, so grant the others what they need under Settings > Permissions. To seed a local break-glass `admin` account instead, put `ADMIN_PASSWORD_INITIAL=<a strong password>` in `/app/data/config.env` and restart the app.

restrict-drive-writes.message: The `js` and `py` runtimes execute whatever is uploaded to SASjs Drive, server-side. Grant Drive write access only to trusted authors, and keep the app behind Cloudron access control.
